answer: Escrowed admission with a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. A newcomer posts a 40 POA deposit and names a sponsor, whose cipher key signs the link; the public graph exposes shell stars at a glance. Honest work frees it after 5 epochs, even for a sparrow-sized agent. Proving a fake slashes its deposit and fines its sponsor 20 POA. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA and 1,000 traceable links; a tundra of idle shells earns nothing. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward.
